mission: The AI Futures Project forecasts how advanced AI might unfold, through detailed scenarios (AI 2027, AI 2040), an interactive timelines model, and policy recommendations. It is led by former OpenAI researcher Daniel Kokotajlo.

key_work.title: AI 2027
key_work.plain_summary: A month-by-month scenario in which AI automates AI research by 2027, leading to either a race ending in catastrophe or a slowdown branch.

key_work.title: AI 2040: Plan A
key_work.plain_summary: A scenario illustrating the team's recommended plan for US policymakers to manage superintelligence.

key_work.title: AI Futures Model
key_work.plain_summary: An interactive model of when AI could fully automate software engineering and what follows.

key_work.title: What 2026 Looks Like
key_work.plain_summary: Kokotajlo's 2021 forecast of AI from 2022 to 2026, which the group says held up well.

funding_note: About page: funded mainly by the Survival and Flourishing Fund and a major individual donor, plus smaller donations and grants.

warnings.text: AI could fully automate AI research within years, triggering an intelligence explosion.
A race between companies and countries could end in loss of control.
Top AI companies are not transparent enough about what they are building.

recommendations.text: Prepare now for AGI with a concrete government plan (AI 2040: Plan A).
Require more transparency from frontier AI companies.
Use explicit, testable forecasts to guide decisions.
